title: AWKUM Students Attend Nexus Pakistan: Building Digital Connections Event at Hazara University, Mansehra
text:
The University Advancement & Career Development Center of AWKUM facilitated students' visits to Hazara University in Mansehra to attend Nexus Pakistan: Building Digital Connections. Students from the departments of Microbiology, Computer Science, and Sociology, as well as the Institute of Business and Leadership (IBL), participated in this visit.
During the event, AWKUM students showcased their innovative research products and projects, reflecting the university's academic excellence and research potential. The event also provided an excellent platform for students to interact with researchers, academicians, and innovators from across the country. These participating students also attended training sessions on the digital transformation of academia and research, thereby empowering the country's youth.
AWKUM students also visited the Vice Chancellor of Hazara University at the Vice Chancellor's office. The Honorable Vice Chancellor, Professor Dr. Ikramullah Khan, welcomed AWKUM students at his office and interacted with them for some time. The vice chancellor encouraged them to take part in such kind of activities and grow professionally. Students of AWKUM sincerely thanked the Vice Chancellor of Hazara University for his humble and respectful interaction with them.
